notes:
- A bar along the bottom of the window says how much is in the folder you are
  looking at, how much of it is unread, and when the app last managed to check
  for mail. If it cannot reach the server it says so there, with how old the
  mail on screen is, instead of a quiet list that looks like a quiet morning.

- Version numbers now line up with the macOS client again. 0.7.0 was a macOS
  fix for a bug this client never had, so there was no Windows 0.7.0.
